conversation.emptyHint: Ask about your emails, the server, or whatever you need.

noKey.title: Key missing
noKey.text: To talk to Jarvis, connect Claude with your key in Assistant → Settings → AI. Everyone uses their own.

direct.label: More direct
direct.text: Get straight to the point: start with the answer, no introductions or detours.

short.label: Short answers
short.text: Short answers: two or three sentences at most, unless I ask for detail.

detailed.label: More detail
detailed.text: Explain in more detail and give the context that helps make sense of the numbers.

noFollowUp.label: No closing questions
noFollowUp.text: Do not end answers with questions or offers of help ("do you want me to…?").

preview.title: See how it looks
preview.description: Answers the last question in the conversation again with these instructions (without saving them yet), so you can compare it with the answer you got.
preview.question: Last question: "{{question}}"

settings.title: Assistant settings
settings.search: Search a setting (e.g. health, telegram, time)…

hints.permissions: What Jarvis can read and change

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: What the agents can read and change, area by area. What you turn off they refuse, and tell you where to turn it back on. It applies on the site, in the app and to every agent.
permissions.healthNote: The overall health summary needs Sleep, Vital signs and Activity with reading on.

email.name: Emails
email.description: Read and summarise emails, search and analyse the inbox.

emailRules.name: Gmail rules
emailRules.description: See rules and proposals. Changing means creating, editing and deleting rules, and analysing, accepting or dismissing proposals.

todos.name: Tasks
todos.description: See your tasks and lists (the Tasks page). Changing is creating, editing, completing and deleting.

healthVitals.name: Vital signs
healthVitals.description: Heart rate, oxygen, skin temperature, stress, blood pressure, glucose and temperature.

healthActivity.name: Activity
healthActivity.description: Steps and workouts, including openGym ones.

healthBody.name: Body
healthBody.description: Weight, body measurements and the health profile.

healthNutrition.name: Nutrition
healthNutrition.description: Water, meals, coffee, alcohol, supplements and fasting.

healthMedical.name: Medical
healthMedical.description: Lab results, medication, appointments, vaccines, exams and conditions.

healthJournal.name: Diary and mood
healthJournal.description: Pain, symptoms, allergies, daily notes, mood, energy and motivation.

servers.name: Servers and services
servers.description: Status of monitored services, notifications, disks and Proxmox.

backups.name: Backups
backups.description: See backups. Changing means running a backup now and creating or editing automatic ones.

serverControl.name: Control machines
serverControl.description: See the configuration and snapshots of VMs and CTs. Changing means start, shut down, reboot, snapshots, backups and resources (Proxmox Operator).

serverShell.name: Server commands
serverShell.description: See the command history. Changing is running commands over SSH (they run right away; agents follow the server rules before changing anything).

forgejo.name: Forgejo
forgejo.description: See repositories, issues, releases, commits and Actions. Changing means creating, commenting on, closing and reopening issues.

team.name: Agent team
team.description: See the agents and tools. Changing means Jarvis creating, changing and deleting agents.

prompts.name: Agent prompts
prompts.description: See the prompts. Changing means Jarvis proposing and applying changes to the agents' instructions.

homeAssistant.name: Home Assistant
homeAssistant.description: See entities, automations, scripts and the log. Changing means controlling devices and creating, changing or deleting automations, scripts, scenes and entities.

adguard.name: AdGuard
adguard.description: See the status, DNS queries, lists and settings. Changing means pausing protection, blocking or allowing domains and managing the lists, rules, rewrites and blocked services.

docs.name: Documents
docs.description: Read and search your documents (rules, checklists, notes). Changing means writing the agents' documents and proposing changes to yours.

updates.name: App updates
updates.description: See the updates, release notes and issues. Changing is saving studies, changing the state, preparing and running an update (as the rules say).

schedules.name: Triggers
schedules.description: See the agents' triggers. Changing is creating, changing and deleting triggers (they run on their own, without you watching).

board.name: Projects (board)
board.description: See, create and change tasks, comment and ask you for answers on the board.

nextcloud.name: Nextcloud
nextcloud.description: See the version, maintenance and the apps inside, with the new versions from the App Store. Changes are made on the server (occ), following the update rules.

opengym.name: openGym (gym)
opengym.description: See the routines, workouts and exercise catalogue. Changing means creating routines and setting the week plan (it never deletes the existing ones).

gametracker.name: GamesTracker (games)
gametracker.description: See the game shelf, the stats, search IGDB and the prices. Changing is adding and editing games on the shelf, removing them (with confirmation) and following prices.

immich.name: Immich (photos)
immich.description: See photos and videos, search (also by description), albums, people, duplicates, jobs and settings. Changing means creating and organising albums, naming people, running jobs and changing settings (it shows what changes first). It never deletes photos.

paperless.name: Paperless (documents)
paperless.description: See and read documents (the OCR text), search, tags, correspondents, types, tasks, workflows and configuration. Changing means filing documents (one or many), adding notes, creating tags, correspondents and types, and changing the configuration (it shows what changes first). It never deletes documents.

trek.name: TREK (trips)
trek.description: See the trips and everything in them through TREK MCP. Changing means creating, changing and (with confirmation) deleting in TREK, within the MCP client scopes.

permissions.layers: There are three places, from the widest to the finest: each agent's tools (Workflow), these areas (for every agent) and each connected app or server (on its page → Agents, per agent). An agent only does what all three allow.

workflow.title: Team workflow
workflow.empty: No activity yet. Talk to Jarvis and whatever the team does shows up here.
workflow.newAgentHint: Choose what it does, who it reports to and which tools it uses.
workflow.talksToYou: Talks to you on the site and in the app

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Reads the bank emails and tells you how much you spent this month.
editor.descriptionHint: This is what its boss reads to decide when to hand it work.
editor.reportsToRoot: Nobody: it talks to you directly, on the site and in the app.
editor.promptPlaceholder: Who it is, what it does, how it uses its tools and what it must never do.
editor.promptHint: They come from the site. You can change them; "Restore the site's" goes back to the originals (and the improvements in new versions).
editor.promptHintCustom: Its team and who it reports to are added at the end automatically.
editor.extraPlaceholder: E.g. label names always in European Portuguese.
editor.extraHint: Added at the end of the instructions. This is what Jarvis changes when you ask it in chat.
editor.toolsHint: It can only use the ones you choose. Those that change things respect the assistant permissions.
editor.deleteHint: Whoever reported to it will report to {{name}}.
editor.created: Agent created — it can take work right away.
editor.saved: Agent saved — it applies from the next message.

toolNames.health_detail: Open a day, night or workout
toolNames.ha_save_config: Create and change automations and scripts
toolNames.adguard_check_domain: Check if a domain is blocked
toolNames.adguard_set_protection: Turn protection on or pause it
toolNames.docs_log: Write to the log of what it did
toolNames.docs_layout: See how the documents are arranged
toolNames.docs_targets: See what a document can link to

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.empty: No conversations yet. Write to Jarvis to start one.

access.title: Agents
access.description: What each agent can do in {{label}}.
access.nobody: No agent has tools for this app (give them in Workflow).
access.noTools: This agent has no tools for this (Workflow).
access.layers: Applies together with the per-area permissions and each agent's tools.
